subject: invalid blocks error when attempting any segmentation analysis

messages.author: 11c5f689b4c9bb24
messages.subject: invalid blocks error when attempting any segmentation analysis
parts:
Hello,

I've been able to get some data nicely processed, can generate plots and images that make sense, however when I attempt to perform any of the segmentation methods (ssc, dgmm, kmeans etc) I consistently get the following error:

calculating spatial weights...
Error in .findSpatialBlocks(.object, groups = run(.object), nblocks = .blocks,  :
  invalid blocks

I can run the examples fine, so I'm kind of stuck as to how to problem solve this. any help would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: 11c5f689b4c9bb24
messages.subject: Re: invalid blocks error when attempting any segmentation analysis
parts:
So after digging around I've resolved the issue and thought I'd update in case anyone else runs into this.

The conversion process in my workflow generates an imzML file which contains x,y, and z coordinates (z=1) even though it is a 2D image. It seems the error was related to this z coordinate. Removing this (coord(data)$z<-NULL) resolved the issue.

I used msconvert to create a mzml file initially from Waters data, then imzMLConverter to create the imzML file.

Aalim
